instructions.question: Does this Facebook comment on the Kosovo public health institute's COVID-19 post express warm approval or hope, an explicit hostile or distressed feeling, or neither (information, requests, suggestions, banter)?
instructions.rule: Neutral is the default. Data requests, 'why' questions, demands for measures, comparisons, calm advice, sarcasm about testing and city 'league' banter stay neutral, even when critical. Choose negative for an explicit marker: blaming anyone (government, citizens, gatherings), fake-number claims, insults, calls to punish, fed-up statements, fear of catastrophe or loss of control, or bitter irony that Kosovo fails. Positive needs praise or defence of doctors, the institute or the government, thanks, relief, or sincere hope for zero cases; praise mixed with criticism stays positive.

neutral.what: Tags, statistics, observations, requests for details, questions, proposals, calm advice, comparisons, jokes and banter, including critical or sarcastic ones.
examples: Mbyllni kufinjt mos luani me jetet e njerzve (Close the borders, don't play with people's lives)
Nëse nuk bëjmë asnjë test, s'do të kemi asnjë rast. U zgjidh problemi. (If we do no tests, we'll have no cases. Problem solved.)
213 ja pafshim hajrin (May we see good from these 213)
neutral.cues: personal names, publikoni (publish), testoni (test), mbyllni (close), pse (why), ma gjall (livelier), on top, hahaha
neutral.not_for: Blame, fake-number claims, insults, calls to punish, being fed up, or fear of catastrophe are negative.

positive.what: Praise, thanks or defence of doctors, the institute or the government; congratulations; sincere hope for no cases; cheering at recoveries.
examples: Respekt per punen tuaj (Respect for your work)
Në asnjë rast nuk mundemi ta fajsojm qeverin por secili duhet fajsu vehten (In no way can we blame the government, everyone should blame themselves)
Ajde ma gjall ma gjall t sherum (Come on, more and more recovered)
positive.cues: bravo (well done), respekt (respect), faleminderit (thanks), urime (congratulations), shpresoj (I hope), inshallah (God willing), asnje rast (no cases), po punon shum (is working hard)
positive.not_for: Ironic 'hajr' or 'ma gjall' over new cases, city-ranking banter and bare good-news headlines are neutral.

negative.what: Blame of government, citizens or gatherings, invented-number claims, insults, calls to punish, fed-up frustration, fear or despair, bitter irony about Kosovo failing.
examples: Namazi i Kurban Bajramit i ka fajet per shtimin e rasteve (The Kurban Bajram prayer is to blame for the rise in cases)
Veq shifren e par pja ndrroni se tekstin tjeter veq copy paste po get (You only change the first number, the rest is copy paste)
Futne more ma shpejt kosoven ne karantin sepse ka mu ba katastrof e madhe (Put Kosovo in quarantine fast, a big catastrophe is coming)
Krejt Rrena (All lies)
negative.cues: faj/fajet (blame), rrena/prralla (lies/fairy tales), aparati (the machine), bajat (stale), lodhet (tired), magari (donkey), pisa (dirty one), injorantat (the ignorant), burg/denim (prison/punishment), pa kontroll (out of control), katastrof (catastrophe), frike (fear)
negative.not_for: Requests, proposals, calm advice, questions or banter without such a marker are neutral.
